name: Ziba
description: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy

points: A servant of the house of Saul named Ziba was brought to David. When David asked whether there was yet any of the house of Saul that he might show the kindness of God unto him, Ziba said Jonathan had yet a son who was lame on his feet, dwelling in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel in Lodebar.

note.label: 2 Samuel 9: David Shows Kindness for Jonathan's Sake

points: Mephibosheth bowed himself and asked what David saw in such a dead dog as he was. David then called Ziba and gave unto his master's son all that pertained to Saul, and charged Ziba, his sons, and his servants to till the land and bring in the fruits, that Mephibosheth might have food, though he himself would eat at the king's table always.

Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants. This shows the level of riches Israel had as a nation: Saul's servant had servants of his own, that is how wealthy this man was, and all of them were set to till the land and take care of the house for Mephibosheth, all out of the respect David had for Jonathan.

note.label: 2 Samuel 9: David Shows Kindness for Jonathan's Sake

points: When David was past the top of the hill, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him with saddled asses, two hundred loaves of bread, a hundred bunches of raisins, a hundred summer fruits, and a bottle of wine. When David asked where his master's son was, Ziba said Mephibosheth abode in Jerusalem, saying the house of Israel would restore him the kingdom of his father. So David gave Ziba all that pertained to Mephibosheth.

Ziba came with gifts, and when David asked about Mephibosheth, Ziba claimed Mephibosheth thought the kingdom was about to be restored to him, which was not true. On that word David handed Ziba everything that belonged to Mephibosheth.

note.label: 2 Samuel 16: Ziba, Shimei's Cursing, and Absalom Defiles the Concubines

points: Shimei the son of Gera the Benjamite hastened down with a thousand men of Benjamin, along with Ziba the servant of Saul's house with his sons and servants, and fell down before the king at Jordan.
